verdict.rationale: Steel's core browser API is published as an open-source repo (steel-browser) with a pre-built Docker image combining the API and UI. That image gives full CDP control via Puppeteer, Playwright or Selenium, plus browser tools, so the core product can be run on your own infrastructure. Steel describes itself as an open-source browser API, and a community commenter calls it an open-source Browserbase. missing for 10: dedicated first-party self-hosting/deployment docs, clarity on which cloud features (CAPTCHA solving, managed proxies, agent traces) are available when self-hosted, and hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.
